rationale: Microsoft 365 E3/E5/E7 is built from Office 365 + EMS + Windows Enterprise; a standalone EMS line is redundant once the customer has any Microsoft 365 suite tier, though EMS E5-specific advanced features (Cloud App Security, ATP) may exceed what a lower M365 tier provides — flag for seller review if migrating EMS E5 into ME3.
Copilot is a separate paid add-on for E3/E5; natively bundled only in E7. A standalone Copilot line becomes redundant only when migrating to E7.
Teams Phone System is bundled starting at Microsoft 365 E5.
Audio Conferencing is bundled starting at Microsoft 365 E5.
A Microsoft 365 family row may represent an existing core suite, so migration to the selected target is suggested for business review.
Office 365 family rows may be core-suite predecessors; migration is a review suggestion, not a verified entitlement mapping.
Power BI Pro is bundled starting at Microsoft 365 E5; not included in E3.
Microsoft 365 E3 includes basic Defender protection; full Defender XDR is only included from E5 upward. Seller must confirm which Defender plan the existing SKU represents.
Teams add-ons and standalone products require exact entitlement review; retain is the conservative suggestion.
Dataverse capacity is normally quantity-specific add-on capacity; retain is suggested pending workload review.
Power Apps is a distinct workload family; retain is suggested until usage and target entitlement are reviewed.
Power Automate products are separately metered and licensed; retain is the conservative suggestion.
Dynamics 365 is a fully separate Microsoft product line, never bundled into any Microsoft 365 Enterprise suite.

Microsoft 365 E3 includes Entra ID P1; E5 includes Entra ID P2; E7 includes the full Entra Suite. Whether a specific existing Entra SKU is redundant depends on its plan level, which this workbook does not indicate — seller must confirm the plan level.
Intune Plan 1 baseline is included from E3; Intune Plan 2 plus Advanced Analytics and Remote Help are only included from E5 upward. Seller must confirm which Intune plan the existing SKU represents.
Project-labelled products are separate workload licences; retain is suggested pending application-owner review.
Visio products are separate applications; retain is suggested until business usage is reviewed.
Standalone Exchange plans may overlap suites, but exact plan equivalence is unverified; retain is suggested.
SharePoint rows include server and cloud variants; retain is suggested until the exact deployment is confirmed.
OneDrive storage and plan variants require capacity review; retain is suggested.
Viva modules have separate entitlement boundaries; retain is suggested until reviewed.
Windows 365 cloud-PC configurations are separate capacity SKUs; retain is suggested.
Windows 11 Enterprise licensing rights are included at all three Microsoft 365 Enterprise tiers.
SQL products are separate server or Azure workloads; retain is suggested.
Universal Print capacity and user products require usage review; retain is suggested.
Power Pages capacity packs are independently metered; retain is suggested.
Purview products span compliance capabilities; retain is suggested until feature overlap is reviewed.
Clipchamp variants are separate application licences; retain is suggested.
Planner variants may include premium project capabilities; retain is suggested pending review.
Advanced Data Residency is an add-on capability visible in the workbook; retain is suggested pending residency-requirement review.
